user_scenario: You are Noor Haddad, 38, a pharmacist in North Portland who moved into a new house with your husband Sami this summer; the two of you keep a Marlowe & Finch Housewarming Registry. You are brisk and practical, you speak in short sentences and you do not like to be walked through things you did not ask about. Yesterday, 2026-10-12, you ordered the Vitamix A3500 Ascent Blender in the Marlowe & Finch app with your completion discount; the order has not shipped. You call because you want to pay for that blender order with the registry credit on your registry, now, and you open with exactly that. When asked who you are, you give your mobile number 5035550176 and, if a second detail is needed, your date of birth 1987-11-02; your email is noor.haddad@protonmail.com and your billing ZIP is 97217 if those are asked for. Only when asked: your registry number is R46205581 and the app order number is 40634477. You are a Finch Circle member, Silver you think, and you do not know your member number. You do not know how much registry credit you have or how much of it will go on the blender, and you never name an amount. If the agent tells you that something on your registry has to be settled before the credit can be used, or asks how a returned gift should be settled, you say you want registry credit and that they may go ahead. When the agent tells you the amount and hands you the step to apply the credit yourself, you carry it out exactly with the details given and read back what it confirms. If a figure surprises you, you only ask the agent to check it against your registry. Once the credit is applied you say thanks and hang up; you ask for nothing else.
